newsitem.title: USA: Carnival says has held talks with Celebrity.
newsitem.headline: Carnival says has held talks with Celebrity.

text.p: Carnival Corp., which is trying to break up the acquisition of Celebrity Cruise Lines by Royal Caribbean Cruises Ltd., said Thursday it and Celebrity have had talks about a possible transaction in the past.
"We have held conversations on and off for a few years," said Carnival spokesman Tim Gallagher.
Although the talks never resulted in a deal, "our interest in Celebrity is well known to them," he said.
Carnival offered to buy Celebrity for $510 million in cash on Monday, according to a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
Celebrity struck a deal to be acquired by Royal Caribbean for $500 million on June 17 in a cash and stock transaction that also called for the assumption of $800 million in debt.
In a letter contained in the filing, Carnival said its offer was superior to the Royal Caribbean transaction, in part because it was all cash.
